verified_facts.text: The hotel's history dates back to 1872.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1872 we have endeavoured to offer you a work of art, as Oscar Wilde used to say

verified_facts.text: The swimming pool was designed by Gio Ponti in 1948 and sits in the hotel's park facing the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Mediterranean sea and the scenographic swimming-pool designed by Gio Ponti in 1948 perfectly complete the park and the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is heated, filled with seawater, has a children's area and is open from April to October.
verified_facts.excerpt: Heated outdoor seawater pool with children's area (April to October)

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a subtropical park, with the sea in front of it.
verified_facts.excerpt: the sight by the subtropical park, the swimming-pool designed by Gio Ponti and the sea in front

verified_facts.text: The Lawrence Lounge in the lobby is named after the hotel's founder, Lorenzo Bertolini.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the name of the hotel's founder Lorenzo Bertolini, the new Lawrence Lounge, the star of our lobby

verified_facts.text: The Lawrence Lounge pairs mixology and cuisine, with live musical entertainment.
verified_facts.excerpt: A place where mixology and cuisine of excellence meet to offer a unique taste experience, at any time of the day. The engaging and cosmopolitan atmosphere, combined with live musical entertainment

verified_facts.text: The restaurants serve Ligurian and Mediterranean cuisine with flavours of land and sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our dishes are full of true flavours of land and sea, conceived and created to offer you the best of typical Ligurian and Mediterranean cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Wellness spa has a Vitarium and a Turkish bath made of pearl mosaic.
verified_facts.excerpt: in the Vitarium at 60°C/140°F, in the Turkish bath at 40°C/104°F made of pearl mosaic

verified_facts.text: The spa's wet zone has a large hydromassage pool, emotional showers, a Turkish bath and a Vitarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Royal Wellness welcomes you in the no prescription wet zone with large hydromassage pool, emotional showers, Turkish bath and Vitarium.

verified_facts.text: Royal Wellness is reserved for adults; guests aged 16 and over may use it when accompanied by an adult.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Wellness is reserved for adult guests. Guests aged 16 and over may also access the wellness area, provided they are accompanied by an adult.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments use the Mei SPA line, made with natural ingredients from Italian officinal plants.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring the exclusive line Mei SPA made with natural phytocosmetic ingredients obtained from officinal plants "Made in Italy"

verified_facts.text: Guests can play tennis and mini-golf on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: You can play tennis or mini-golf on site.

verified_facts.text: The tennis court is an illuminated synthetic turf court, with private lessons and equipment rental available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tennis enthusiasts will find a regular illuminated synthetic turf court. They can book private lessons and rent equipment too.

verified_facts.text: The 18-hole Circolo Golf degli Ulivi, designed by Peter Gannon and inaugurated in 1932, sits on the hill above Sanremo among olive and mimosa trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: The "Circolo Golf degli Ulivi" is a true gem, designed by Peter Gannon and inaugurated in 1932. It has 18 holes and is nestled amidst olive and mimosa trees on the hill above Sanremo

verified_facts.text: A 33-kilometre seaside pedestrian and cycling path runs from Ospedaletti to Imperia, passing through Sanremo.
verified_facts.excerpt: It runs for 33 kilometres by the sea, just perfect for cycling, running, walking and skating.

verified_facts.text: Sea excursions into the Pelagos Sanctuary marine protected area offer the chance to spot dolphins and whales.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Pelagos Sanctuary, a protected marine area where nature reveals itself in all its magnificence. During exclusive sea excursions, guests can enjoy the rare thrill of spotting dolphins, whales

verified_facts.text: Children up to 6 stay free when sharing their parents' room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children free of charge up to 6 years, sharing parents' room

verified_facts.text: Family facilities include a kids' playroom, a playground and a kids' menu on request in all restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minigolf and playground - Kids' playroom - Special kids' menu on request in all restaurants

verified_facts.text: In July and August a pizzeria runs at the Corallina Restaurant by the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pizzeria in July and August at the Corallina Restaurant by the pool

verified_facts.text: Sanremo is about 60 minutes from Nice International Airport and 45 minutes from Monte-Carlo.
verified_facts.excerpt: just 60 minutes from Nice International airport and 45 minutes from Monte-Carlo

verified_facts.text: Sanremo railway station is about 1.8 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sanremo railway station is located about 1.8 km (1,1 miles) from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Nearby landmarks include the medieval old town known as La Pigna, the Russian Orthodox Church and the Casino.
verified_facts.excerpt: the medieval old town centre known as "La Pigna", the Russian Orthodox Church

verified_facts.text: The Royal Golf Challenge, a two-day weekend tournament with a gala dinner at the hotel, takes place every year at the end of October.
verified_facts.excerpt: takes place every year at the end of October: an unmissable event featuring a two-day weekend tournament combined with moments of elegance and conviviality, including a gala dinner

verified_facts.text: The front desk can arrange private transfers on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private transfers and can be arranged by our Front Desk upon request.
